preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 500000 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: The number of vertices n in each test case is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(colors) == n for n, colors in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [input().strip() for _ in range(T)]))
preconditions.description: The length of the color string is equal to the number of vertices n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'WN' for c in colors) for colors in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each character in the color string is either 'W' or 'N'.

preconditions.expression: all(any(c == 'N' for c in colors) for colors in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: There is at least one uncolored vertex in each test case.

preconditions.expression: all('WWW' not in ''.join(sorted(colors * 2)) for colors in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: There is no path of three white vertices in the initial configuration.

postconditions.expression: all(result in ['White', 'Draw', 'Black'] for result in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either 'White', 'Draw', or 'Black'.
The number of results in the output is equal to the number of test cases T.
